detail.note: replication of tsmom.252 on an independent market (30 US ETFs/large caps via yfinance, 2019-2026). The original pass was crypto-only; a single-market single-class panel is one beta wearing 30 tickers. Cross-market agreement is why this one graduates to shadow-book forward runs.

The 2026-08-17 batch ran on a crypto-only panel (Stooq bot-walled the equity fetch; yfinance replaces it). tsmom.252's crypto pass is superseded by the equities replication; the thin 'fail' entries (donchian, rsi2, bbands, adx, turn-of-month, turtle_soup, pullback) were n<30 on one class and remain untested, not failed. Re-run pending on the mixed panel.

The two-proportion paired z on the extended 2012 panel showed 7/11 passing -- an artifact. Strategy and baseline calls share dates, assets, and regime drift, so their outcomes are correlated and the independent-samples z inflates badly (turn-of-month 6.22 -> 0.95 under McNemar). All extended-window results superseded by *.extended_2012 entries, which use McNemar on discordant pairs. tsmom.252 is the sole survivor: +3.94 discordant, consistent with its short-window and equities-only replications.
